local data={
	---- Valley IV ----
	["Ankhorilling Kitchenware (pkg)"]={name="Ankhorilling Kitchenware (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="This set of kitchen utensils is only related to Ankhors because they were made using raw materials derived from Ankhors. During the First Aggeloi War, people who lack metal would kill Aggeloi that spawned in metal-rich environments, then use their remains to make kitchenware. Ankhorilling pots and pans feature smooth, non-stick surfaces, zero pits, and great thermal conductance. These excellent properties ensure that Ankhor-based kitchenware crafting gets passed on till this very day.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Musbeast Scrimshaw Dangles (pkg)"]={name="Musbeast Scrimshaw Dangles (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="An ornamental dangle made using musbeast bones carved into various shapes. During early development of Valley IV, Sarkaz workers were employed to support various projects. Before concluding their contracts, the Sarkaz would present fellow Valley IV crew mates with musbeast scrimshaw dangles carved into the shapes of various machines. Witchcraft within the dangles also lets them float temporarily above Originium batteries. The dangles gradually became a common piece of decor in major cities and frontier areas of the Civilization Band.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Witchcraft Mining Drill (pkg)"]={name="Witchcraft Mining Drill (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A rather primitive machine jointly developed by the UWST and Seš'qa. These drills are often made using Origocrust imbued with witchcraft and commonly installed on the transport belts of various Originium factories. They can penetrate Origocrusts effectively without damaging the mineral kernel.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Aggeloi War Tins (pkg)"]={name="Aggeloi War Tins (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="These tinned provisions date all the way back to the end of the First Aggeloi War, which means they have been around for more than a century. Please do not open or consume its contents. They are meant to provide spiritual encouragement far more satisfying than a filled belly.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Valley Hydroculture Fillets (pkg)"]={name="Valley Hydroculture Fillets (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="Scientifically inspired by the myosin hydrocultures of Originium agricultural research. These fillets are grown in the meat-packing plants in the regions around Valley IV. Please overlook the fact that the flavor, texture, and gastronomic trauma of hydroculture fillets are akin to those inflicted by soggy bread. These fillets are at least capable of peristaltic locomotion that lets them slowly squirm across a table.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Unity Syrup (pkg)"]={name="Unity Syrup (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A stash of orally administered syrups for Oripathy prophylaxis. In Talos-II, a daily regimen of the prophylactic syrup can effectively reduce the risks of contracting Oripathy.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Seš'qamam Knucklebones (pkg)"]={name="Seš'qamam Knucklebones (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A toy made in Seš'qa. The player starts by calling out the result of a throw. If they miss, the witchcraft of the knucklebones will cause a flower to sprout on the head of the player. The flower lasts for 30 minutes.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Astarron Crystals (pkg)"]={name="Astarron Crystals (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="Blocks of crystals found within the remains of the giant Aggelos that once attacked Valley IV. Most were moved to various institutions for research and testing. However, given the beauteous appearances and ample supply of the crystals, many were fashioned into brooches, necklaces, and other jewelry by the workers.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Scrap Toy Blocks (pkg)"]={name="Scrap Toy Blocks (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A set of building blocks made using scrap stone, metal, and wood. Many workers spent their break time (when they're not dismantling the Aggeloi or recycling various resources) building various things with all sorts of easy-to-find scraps. Someone eventually took this concept and created a franchise of toys out of it.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Originium Saplings (pkg)"]={name="Originium Saplings (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="An Originium formation that looks like a young sapling. After the destruction of the Great Originium Oak, the UWST began farming these saplings on a large scale. Each of them has a chance of growing into a new Oak. Though hardly any saplings showed any sign of growth, they remain highly sought after by Originium scientists from across the world.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Vigilant Pickaxes (pkg)"]={name="Vigilant Pickaxes (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="Pickaxes commonly used by miners working in Valley IV. They are fitted with special alarms that give off sharp warning sounds if the pickaxe sustains damage due to undetectable Blight in rock formations.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	["Hard Noggin Helmets (pkg)"]={name="Hard Noggin Helmets (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="\"Hard Noggin. Guaranteed to keep your head in one piece.\"", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Valley IV Stock Redistribution"},
	---- Wuling ----
	["Wuling Frozen Pears Bundle"]={name="Wuling Frozen Pears Bundle", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="Rumors say that Wuling City grade schoolers can tell actual frozen fruits from those processed and made with Originium Arts. Do not lie to the children.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Eureka Anti-smog Tincture (pkg)"]={name="Eureka Anti-smog Tincture (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="This Eureka Teashop product has been hampered by poor sales. Most consumers criticized it for its strangely sour and bitter taste. But one day came when people started believing it has the abilities to alleviate the discomfort caused by being too close to the Blight.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Nymphsprout (pkg)"]={name="Nymphsprout (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="\"A hibernating nymph in winter, a budding sprout by summer.\" — Sishi Zhulinchong Kaolue (literally translated as: A Study of Grovenymphs in Different Seasons)", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Wuxia Movies (pkg)"]={name="Wuxia Movies (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="Video tapes of top rated movies in Wuling. This anthology of six Wuxia thrillers (with a narrative structure inspired by that used in the Six Criminal Heists) illustrates the founding and history of Wuling. In fact, this anthology is publicly acclaimed as the easiest way to learn about Wuling City. Though one can readily find this anthology in many households, recent sales have spiked for reasons unknown.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Chubby Lung Tianshi (pkg)"]={name="Chubby Lung Tianshi (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A cute and lovely keychain fob featuring Chubby Lung — Honorary Tianshi, mascot of Wuling City, and ultimate winner of the TGCC Mascot Championships. Altogether, 36 varieties have been officially released thus far. Completing the Chubby Lung collection is a quest undertaken by Wulingers of every age.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Xiran-Hue Fireworks (pkg)"]={name="Xiran-Hue Fireworks (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with cultural commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="These fireworks explode into blossoms of brilliant Xiranite jade. Unfortunately, the manufacturer has not added any actual Xiranite to cut costs.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Xiranite Filter Cores (pkg)"]={name="Xiranite Filter Cores (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A classical example of successfully adapting Wuling Xiranite technology for civilian water purification. These water filter cores are one of the reasons why Wuling is a household name in Talos-II.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Qingbo Rafts (pkg)"]={name="Qingbo Rafts (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A family version of the Wuling Outskirts bamboo raft. Since this is an export version, it comes with a Xiranite hybrid drive technology. Many residents in coastal cities purchased the raft to take part in the Siesta Surfing Festival.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Aerial Receptionists (pkg)"]={name="Aerial Receptionists (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A suite of advertising drones. A Wuling proprietor received customer complaints when he added the drones to the waiting staff and made them play ads non-stop.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Wuling Frozen Pears (pkg)"]={name="Wuling Frozen Pears (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with daily commodities. Such goods are subject to moderate price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="Rumors say that Wuling City grade schoolers can tell actual frozen fruits from those processed and made with Originium Arts.", obtain="Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Swordmancer Forge (pkg)"]={name="Swordmancer Forge (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. 	["Xiranite Bridge (pkg)"]={name="Xiranite Bridge (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. 	["Marker Stone Lock (pkg)"]={name="Marker Stone Lock (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. They can also be used in Stock Redistribution to generate revenue.", desc="A civilian version of defense systems employed at the Main Pillar. Marker Stone devices can link to local facility security systems to create the perfect barrier.", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Chubby Lung Blimp (pkg)"]={name="Chubby Lung Blimp (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations. All shall look upon thee and be awed by the wuv-wuv-wuv!", obtain="Purchasable at Stock Redistribution, Purchase: Wuling Stock Redistribution"},
	["Tianshi Pillar Cores (pkg)"]={name="Tianshi Pillar Cores (pkg)", tier=2, use="A package loaded with local industrial commodities. Such goods are subject to large price fluctuations.
